{{Quote|The Jedi way was not for me, and we both know that it is not truly for you either.|Acaadi, convincing Duqua Dar to leave the Jedi path|<ref name="ID" />}}
'''Acaadi''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]]. During the war, he served alongside fellow Zabrak [[Duqua Dar]], allying himself with the [[Revanchist]]s&mdash;a group of Jedi led by then-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who went against the orders of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and took an active role in the war. Revan led the Republic forces during the war but came to accept [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings in the process. Acaadi's dedication to Revan likewise eventually turned him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and he became a Sith agent at the start of the [[Jedi Civil War]], which began when [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]] led an invasion of the Republic. While working as a Sith agent, Acaadi developed a reputation as a skilled corrupter of Jedi and Republic citizens.

On [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], Acaadi was tasked with sabotaging Republic forces on and in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], in preparation for a Sith raid against the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] there. He infiltrated a group of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], using them to [[Mission on Iridonia|destroy]] a [[Iridonia communications center|Republic communications center]], and later in a plot to turn Duqua Dar to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Acaadi was pursued by a group of Jedi and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working as agents for the Republic, who attempted to thwart his plans. The Republic agents followed Acaadi to the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Republic fleet, the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Champion of Iridonia]]'', which was situated in orbit. There, they engaged Acaadi, as well as a team of [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith commandos]] under his command, with the fate of the Republic fleet hanging in the balance.

==Biography==
===Mandalorian Wars===
{{Quote|You didn't listen to me back then, and where did it get you? Nowhere.|Acaadi, to Duqua Dar|<ref name="ID" />}}
[[File:Iridonia.jpg|250px|thumb|Acaadi's homeworld of Iridonia]]
During his time as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Acaadi traveled to the [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] and [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] to study the [[Keetael]] and [[Luka Sene]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] traditions, respectively. He served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]], allying himself with the [[Revanchist]]s&mdash;a group of Jedi led by then-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who went against the orders of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and took an active role in the conflict. Leading the Republic forces in the war, Revan discovered ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings and came to embrace them. During the early part of the Mandalorian Wars, Acaadi served alongside fellow Zabrak Jedi [[Duqua Dar]], before Acaadi's dedication to Revan eventually turned him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Dar, however, resisted the call of the dark side and remained on the Zabrak homeworld of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], though he believed that his destiny lay elsewhere.<ref name="ID" />

Acaadi became a Sith agent at the beginning of the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="ID" /> which began when [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]] led an invasion of the Galactic Republic in [[3959 BBY]].<ref name="KotORI">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> In this role, Acaadi developed a reputation as a corrupter of Jedi and Republic citizens or supporters alike.<ref name="ID" />

===Sith agent===
At the start of the Jedi Civil War, Acaadi infiltrated a group of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on Iridonia, disguising himself in red [[Rally Master]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], which was worn by the middle ranks of the Neo-Crusaders. Convincing them to follow his leadership, Acaadi ultimately used the Mandalorians to [[Mission on Iridonia|attack]] a [[Iridonia communications center|Republic communications center]] in order to destroy it in advance of a planned Sith attack on Iridonia. Having succeeded in their task, the Mandalorians became a liability to Acaadi, so he planned to remove them in such a way as to benefit him. He used his [[Force power/Legends|ability]] to [[Farsight/Legends|peer into the future]] to set up a situation where he could remove the Mandalorians while working to divide Duqua Dar from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and potentially turn him to the dark side to join the Sith cause.<ref name="ID" />

[[File:WortanMap-ID.png|250px|thumb|left|Wortan, the location of Acaadi's private hangar]]
As the Mandalorians retreated from the communications center, they split into two groups while heading for a rendezvous near the city of [[Wortan]]; one of which was encountered by Dar, while the other was ambushed and eliminated by a group of Jedi and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], who were under orders from the Republic. Acaadi saved Dar from the Mandalorians and used the encounter to persuade Dar to join him. Dar was convinced that the Jedi Order had been holding him back, preventing him from using his natural aggressive feelings. The conversation between the two Zabrak was overheard via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] by the Republic agents. They were unaware that Dar had agreed to join Acaadi, however, and so they decided to go to Dar's aid.<ref name="ID" />

Acaadi and Dar traveled to Acaadi's private [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in Wortan, with the Republic agents in pursuit. Reaching Wortan, the Republic agents searched the city for the two Zabrak, and in the process they met two unexpected allies: the male Draethos [[Darok-Tho]] and the female Miraluka [[Jirany Sha]], who were practitioners of Keetael and Luka Sene, respectively, the very Force traditions Acaadi had studied earlier in his travels as a Jedi. The two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] had been ordered to Iridonia because of their masters' [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]], so that they could help the Republic agents stop Acaadi. They believed the Sith agent was using techniques he'd learned while studying their respective Force traditions to corrupt Jedi and further [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="ID" />

===Confrontation on the ''Champion of Iridonia''===
{{Quote|I'm sorry, Admiral, but you're too late, as are your Jedi friends. Again.|Acaadi, to Admiral Rokon aboard the ''Champion of Iridonia''|<ref name="ID" />}}
With the help of Darok-Tho and Sha, the Republic agents managed to locate Acaadi's hangar. Acaadi detected the group as they approached and ordered the hangar's guards to withdraw from the hangar's exterior, as he preferred to rather have the Republic agents meet with Dar in the hangar, which was being watched by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of his [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith commandos]] hidden among nearby debris. Just as the agents arrived, Acaadi left the planet in his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with another group of Sith commandos, heading for the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in Iridonia's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Champion of Iridonia]]''. He planned to sabotage the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in preparation for the surprise Sith raid against the Republic fleet. After the Republic agents attempted to convince Dar to reject the dark side and were forced to battle the Sith commandos who attacked at Acaadi's command, they discovered Acaadi's plan and raced to the ''Champion of Iridonia'' to warn [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Rokon]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Republic fleet.<ref name="ID" />

As the Republic agents approached the ''Champion of Iridonia'', the Sith fleet arrived to begin its [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|attack]]. Acaadi boarded the ''Champion of Iridonia'', wearing an ill-fitting [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic naval]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] uniform, and took his commandos to an [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] station. The crew of the ''Champion of Iridonia'' discovered the Sith agent's location through security feeds, as Acaadi and his commandos sabotaged the ship. Acaadi turned to one of the cameras and spoke to Admiral Rokon, telling him he was too late. At that moment, Acaadi's group sent a burst of electrical energy through the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] control panels, killing the crew and wounding the admiral. Moving to take over the ship, Acaadi and his commandos attacked the bridge, but the Republic agents, who had also arrived aboard, engaged Acaadi and his commandos in an attempt to save the ''Champion of Iridonia'', with the fate of the Republic fleet resting on their shoulders.<ref name="ID" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;always the risky one.|Duqua Dar, describing Acaadi|<ref name="ID" />}}
Acaadi was a male Zabrak who had [[Color/Legends|whitish]] skin covered in a complex pattern of black, flowing [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] of stylized knots and strands, which encircled the eight small horns on his head. The pattern of the tattoos made it look as if he had a mask across his piercing red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He used a similar entwined black-and-white pattern on the hilt of his [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="ID" />

Acaadi had a charismatic personality that he combined with his knowledge of the Force to corrupt others. Jirany Sha's Luka Sene mentor would tell her tales that as a young Jedi, Acaadi was always secretive and disruptive, despite his interest in non-Jedi Force knowledge. In addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Acaadi could speak [[Draethos (language)|Draethos]] and [[Zabraki/Legends|Zabraki]]. He possessed a low, smooth voice, and spoke with a classic Iridonian accent<ref name="ID" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You saw what I did to your attackers. You can wield that same power, if you would just open yourself to it.|Acaadi, after saving Duqua Dar from the Mandalorians|<ref name="ID" />}}
Acaadi was a knowledgeable Force-user who had learned many techniques as both a Jedi and Sith, as well as through his studies with various Force-using groups. He was capable of seeing glimpses of other places and other times through the use of farseeing, and he could also use [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Acaadi could [[Force stealth|hide his Force presence]] from other Force-users at will, as well as [[Mind trick/Legends|influence]] the minds of others, allowing him to escape detection.<ref name="ID" />

In combat, Acaadi preferred to focus on using [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] rather than [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. He was skilled in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] applications of the Force, able to lift beings into the air during engagements.<ref name="ID" />

==Equipment==
Acaadi carried a red-bladed lightsaber he built with an entwined black-and-white pattern on the hilt. He also possessed a heavy [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. For the assault on the ''Champion of Iridonia'', Acaadi wore a stolen Republic naval lieutenant's uniform,<ref name="ID" />

==Behind the scenes==
Acaadi was the primary villain for ''[[Iridonian Darkness]]'', an online [[Wizards of the Coast]] adventure written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', which was made available as a free download from [[Wizards.com]] on [[October 8]], [[2008]].<ref name="ID" />

In ''Iridonian Darkness'', player choices affect the actions of Acaadi during the game. When the Republic agents meet with Duqua Dar in Acaadi's hangar, if Dar chooses the dark side, Acaadi orders him to dispatch with the Republic agents and join him in destroying the Republic fleet. However, if Dar is redeemed, Acaadi orders his commandos to kill them all. During the final encounter aboard the ''Champion of Iridonia'', if Jirany Sha and Darok-Tho are with the Republic agents, Acaadi will taunt them about how he has used what he learned from their traditions to corrupt Jedi and others across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At the end of the game, depending on the actions of the players it is possible for Acaadi to both [[Death/Legends|die]] in the final encounter or flee in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].<ref name="ID" />
